items.title: Fortis Healthcare Q1 Results: Profit rises 2.3% to Rs 273 crore
items.description: Fortis Healthcare's financial report for the first quarter showcases a promising 2.3 percent rise in profit. The consolidated profit after tax now stands at Rs 273 crore, reflecting growth from last year. Additionally, revenue surged 17.5 percent to reach Rs 2,545 crore. The hospital segment thrived, alongside successful diagnostics operations. Leaders of the company highlighted ongoing investment in infrastructure and a positive business momentum for the future.

items.title: Muthoot Microfin Q1 profit jumps 13-fold on stronger loan growth
items.description: Muthoot Microfin reported a more than 13-fold rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 81 crore, driven by 49% higher loan disbursements, lower credit costs and improved asset quality. Gross loan portfolio grew 18%, while net interest margin remained stable at 12%.

items.title: Britannia Q1 Results: Profit rises 14% to Rs 593 crore on volumes, price rise
items.description: India's ​Britannia ​Industries reported first-quarter ​profit below market expectations on Thursday, ‌as ⁠higher ⁠expenses linked ​to the Middle East ​conflict overshadowed stronger demand for ​its packaged ⁠foods.

items.title: Crompton Greaves Q1 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 142 crore, revenue up 11%
items.description: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals has reported a remarkable 15.17 percent increase in net profit for the June quarter, alongside an 11.84 percent rise in revenue from operations. The company has successfully achieved double-digit growth across all its business segments, bolstered by strategic price hikes and enhanced cost efficiencies. This impressive performance underscores the ongoing growth momentum the company is experiencing.
